parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records is `EntityResolverMockCache` located at `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsAPIEntityResolverCachingTests.swift:20`, which resides in a test target. Per the decision rules, any cluster where at least one record is a test fixture must be treated as intentional duplication. The mock cache exists to satisfy test-isolation requirements for `DiscogsAPIEntityResolverCachingTests` and deliberately mirrors the shape of `InMemoryCache` without being the same artefact. Lifting production code from `Shared/Caching/Sources/Caching/InMemoryCache.swift` to share an implementation with a test mock would couple production semantics to test semantics, which is the canonical restraint pattern.
